ScenarioDescriptions.internship-2026-001: Full cycle: coordinator account setup -> application -> student confirmation -> placement -> tasks & resubmission -> supervisor review -> weekly hours -> company and academic final evaluations -> coordinator approval -> completion report sample
ScenarioDescriptions.internship-2026-002: Final-review scenario: confirmed placement, tasks & hours completed, both evaluations submitted, coordinator holds approval until missing completion-letter evidence is supplied
ScenarioDescriptions.student-03: Negative/open scenario: rejected application and a later pending application, with no internship or tasks until acceptance and confirmation

CriticalNotes: All people and company names are fictional, not a representation of GJU or actual employers.
Four pre-existing Firebase Auth UIDs/emails from the input are preserved to limit breaking existing logins; display names are demonstration placeholders and should be checked.
Three REPLACE_WITH_FIREBASE_AUTH_UID_* keys must be replaced with Auth UIDs after accounts are actually created; all references must be replaced too.
Firebase Realtime Database import does not create Firebase Authentication users or passwords.
New nodes model required workflows but may require corresponding ASP.NET pages/models and Firebase security rules.
Grading policy and some workflow decisions are explicitly hypothetical; no claim of an officially approved GJU grade split.
Completion PDF sample is a separate non-official illustrative file. Upload it to Firebase Storage and set PdfUrl before the application can genuinely serve it.
